def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # frame interior partitioned into four equal blocks; colors indicated by two outside markers.
    coords=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,5)]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=coords
    # Color markers arranged horizontally. Same-side vertical position determines diagonal layout.
    a,b=grid[r1][c1],grid[r2][c2]
    top,bottom=(min(r1,r2),max(r1,r2))
    # Marker above frame: diagonal same as source; below frame: invert vertical association
    flip = r1>7 or r2>7
    # Discover frame bounds
    rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c]==5 for row in grid)]
    r0,rn=min(rows),max(rows); c0,cn=min(cols),max(cols)
    midr=(r0+rn)//2; midc=(c0+cn)//2
    for r in range(r0+1,rn):
        for c in range(c0+1,cn):
            upper=r<=midr; left=c<=midc
            use_a=(upper==left)
            if flip: use_a=not use_a
            out[r][c]=a if use_a else b
    return out
PY
